population.weights: Exact original weights retained through bound read-plan population; no pooling or removal.

phase_boundaries.before_phase2: Durably freeze all 1548 origins or explicit failures before any forecast-clock read.
phase_boundaries.before_phase3: Durably freeze all 1548 candidate futures or explicit failures before I/E/truth decode.
phase_boundaries.inside_phase1: history_clock_checks and input_anchor_checks must return before initializers/LS/RHS. Source identity precedes model construction.
phase_boundaries.inside_phase3: Reference identity/refinement precedes scoring; no candidate changes; parameters-final is last scientific/identity scope.

count_semantics.operators: Each listed process/operator is a real callback. Sum includes nested wrappers and is not a count of disjoint numerical primitives.
count_semantics.complete_scope: Every operator attempted=returned=cap; every derived and diagnostic operation count equals its registered successful limit.
count_semantics.diagnostics: For every listed kind, explicit helper attempted and returned counts each equal the limit on success. These are array operations, not scalar audits.
count_semantics.derived: RK4 completion sink and actual quadrature matmul counts, plus numeric bytes of memory identity hashes. No dummy callbacks.
count_semantics.observation_map: One map per initializer, already included in quadrature_proxy matmul. Never counted twice in diagnostic matmul.
count_semantics.ls_array_operations: The ls callback contains two additional matrix-vector products (1548 campaign total), not included in diagnostic matmul=4644.
count_semantics.reference_hashes: Six E concatenations [72405,22] f8; one truth [72405,20] f8; one clock [72405] f8; one offsets [259] i8. Nine actual in-memory hashes; no reopening old bulk archives.
count_semantics.parameter_hash_bytes: Six logical numeric fingerprints, each 183 f8=1464 bytes. Any names/dtype/shape framing is separately measured, not claimed as numeric bytes.

failure_rules.numerical_failure: Keep actual attempted/returned prefix and all saved partials; unused cap is consumed and cannot transfer; no retry.
failure_rules.prerequisite_failed: Preserve every scope identity, original allocation and weights; actual operators/derived/diagnostics are zero. Bind failed prerequisites explicitly.
failure_rules.global_failure: Source/identity/budget/log/save errors and failed-scope retry attempts poison the campaign; only independent failure evidence saving remains.
failure_rules.interruption: Open scopes unknown/spent; no resume. Never infer returned operations from reservation.
failure_rules.population_aggregation: Still invoke fixed group/paired summaries to retain missing-weight evidence; dependency failure does not authorize deletion or a complete-case improvement gate.

process_io_record_count_advice.assumptions: At most one JSON/NPZ result pair plus reserved/closed markers per scope; <=64 global files including failure artifacts; two persistent journals. At most write, initial hash and final-manifest hash per output file, plus one byte-range read of the scientific journal per scope closure, each attempted+terminal. Scientific/reader stream line writes are counted by their own transition limits, not recursively re-logged as body-file IO.
process_io_record_count_advice.bytes: Measure actual source/output/hash/write bytes, including failed prefixes. Do not fabricate a compressed-output byte bound. Source reader fixed bytes and header maxima retain their separate exact definitions.
process_io_record_count_advice.header_bytes: Actual descriptor header bytes <= frozen per-member10000 and global204060000; never a claim that maximum bytes were actually read.
